name: Yoshikawa Nao
source: University student. Sought out help for his erectile dysfunction from his friend, who suggested he visit a urologist. His friend told him Yoshikawa's chosen clinic had a doctor that was "an old guy and all the nurses were old ladies," but this turns out not to be the case.
